statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness
These symptoms have persisted despite medical management
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
Diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42 support the service
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
